# Training volume tracker

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/training-volume/

Calculate workout load from sets, repetitions and external weight. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Enter squat and row sets to total repetitions and weight-times-repetitions for the session.

## Limits and checks

Volume here means external load multiplied by repetitions. It does not measure recovery, muscle stimulus or bodyweight exercise difficulty.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
